summary: Iteration 14 — backend route-extraction refactor + Compliance Profile tab + contact-invite toast. Backend pytest 7/7 passing against the preview backend. Verified: (a) GET /api/clients/directory (super_admin) returns clients[]/portfolio{}/attention_queue[]/team_workload[] with all pre-refactor fields (client_id, name, program_status, past_due, due_30d, due_31_90d, critical_high_open, unassigned + portfolio aggregates); (b) GET /api/clients/directory as contributor@acme.demo => 403; (c) GET /api/baseline/templates returns policies (len=8), risks (len=6), review_templates (len=10, each with title/review_type/recurrence/due_days); (d) POST /api/baseline as super_admin creates policies:1 risks:1 reviews:1 for authorized client; (e) POST /api/baseline as readonly@acme.demo => 403; (f) POST /api/baseline with foreign client_id as contributor => 403 (tenant isolation); (g) POST /api/contacts/{id}/invite creates a fresh user with unique email, returns invite_link (APP_BASE_URL is set → link points at /reset-password?token=…), and links the contact. Frontend Playwright verified on /client-settings as platform.admin@grc.demo (Globex Ltd active): both tabs render (tab-users-access + tab-compliance-profile). Clicking Compliance Profile renders the three summary cards (compliance-summary-total=3, applicable=2, review=0) and ALL five buckets (assurance=1, legal=1, contractual=0, insurance=0, other=1) — counts add up to total. FAILING: RecordDrawer 'Invite to Platform' button DOES NOT RENDER for a contact drawer — renderContactActions() is defined at RecordDrawer.jsx:331 but is never invoked from the JSX tree (grep confirms zero call sites). The button, its data-testid `contact-invite`, and the invite-panel container `contact-actions` never appear when opening a contact with an email and no linked_user_id. The backend flow works end-to-end (verified via test_contact_invite_flow) — this is purely a missing JSX render call.

ui_bugs.issue: `renderContactActions()` is defined but never called from the JSX. As a result, the 'Invite to Platform' button (data-testid=contact-invite) and the platform-access panel (data-testid=contact-actions) never render in the Contacts drawer. Add `{kind === "contacts" && renderContactActions()}` alongside the other `kind === ...` guards in `renderFields()` (RecordDrawer.jsx:907-909).

integration_issues.issue: Because the Invite button never renders, the 'Copy link' toast action added in this iteration is unreachable from the UI. The toast code itself (RecordDrawer.jsx:311-323) is correct (label='Copy link', duration=10000, action.onClick copies invite_link) — only the entry point is broken.

action_items: RecordDrawer.jsx: invoke renderContactActions() from renderFields() when kind === 'contacts' so the Invite to Platform button is actually rendered. Suggested insertion at line ~909 alongside the other kind-guarded panels.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~3584 lines. The next candidate for extraction (matching this iteration's pattern) is the /api/users + /api/contacts/{id}/invite block (~lines 667-810) into routes/users.py — it would eliminate ~140 lines of unrelated invite/email HTML from the main module.

routes/portfolio.py and routes/baseline.py both re-import symbols from `server` at module load. Because server.py wires include_router at the bottom (after helpers), this works — but the circular-import comment should be tightened to name the exact helpers each module needs so a future refactor doesn't accidentally introduce a top-level import cycle.

The invite email HTML in server.py (lines 784-798) embeds inline styles for a button. Consider extracting to a small template helper (or Jinja) so the tenant_phrase/role_phrase logic is testable in isolation and doesn't grow inside admin_create_user.
ClientSettings.jsx bucketize() runs on every render even though `requirements` only changes on load. Wrap in useMemo(() => bucketize(requirements), [requirements]) — trivial win.

The 'Other Obligations' bucket uses `match: () => true` as a catch-all AND is also iterated in `buckets.map`, so requirements matching e.g. 'legal' cannot fall through to 'other' — this is correct. But the design intends 'Other' to be a fallback only; consider renaming the field to `fallback: true` and evaluating outside the loop to make the intent explicit.

rca of the issue: Bug: 'Invite to Platform' button never renders in the contact drawer. Root cause: RecordDrawer.jsx defines function renderContactActions() at line 331 but the JSX render tree (renderFields → line 905-912) only guards `kind === 'reviews' | 'findings' | 'policies'`. There is no `kind === 'contacts'` branch calling renderContactActions(). Reproduction: login as platform.admin@grc.demo, open /contacts, click any contact with an email and no linked_user_id → drawer opens with Overview/Related/Evidence/Comments/Activity tabs and shows Full name/Job title/Primary GRC role/Email/Phone/Linked platform user/Status/Notes fields, but there is no Platform access panel and no Invite button anywhere on the page (verified via `page.query_selector_all('[data-testid="contact-invite"]')` → 0 matches). Mitigation: add `{kind === 'contacts' && renderContactActions()}` in the default branch of renderFields() at RecordDrawer.jsx:906-911, or render it above the schema map.
